extra.final_summary:
Total body mass (g) per species: Gentoo 160,050 g; Adelie 78,775 g; Chinstrap 28,400 g (60 rows used).

Problems found and fixed:
1. species label variants — "adelie" (1 row) and "gentoo" (2 rows) were merged into the allowed labels "Adelie" and "Gentoo" via normalize_labels (per rules file's allowed values). Without this, the totals would have been split across 5 groups instead of 3.
2. Exact duplicate rows — rows 18 and 59 were exact copies of earlier rows and were dropped (drop_duplicates, approved), so their body mass is not double-counted.

Checks that came back clean: body_mass_g had no text-numbers, no non-numeric values, no negatives, and no values outside the rules range [2500, 6500].

Caveats: flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values (out of the rules range 170–235), but that column is not used in this question, so I left it untouched. The island column also contains "Bisco" and "Dram" variants, likewise unused here. Totals reflect the cleaned copy (60 rows after de-duplication).
